keypoints.name: PID Control
keypoints.description: The video focuses on PID (Proportional, Integral, Derivative) control as a feedback mechanism for stabilizing a one-axis system, which is analogous to drone flight control.  It explains the error calculation, the proportional, integral, and derivative constants, and how they contribute to motor control.

keypoints.name: MPU6050 IMU
keypoints.description: The video explains how to use the MPU6050 Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) to obtain gyro and accelerometer data, which is then filtered and used to calculate the real inclination angle of the system. This angle serves as feedback for the PID control loop.
